title: Binance Will List Worldcoin (WLD)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list Worldcoin (WLD) and tentatively set to open trading for these spot trading pairs at  2023-07-24 09:00 (UTC) :  New Spot Trading Pairs : WLD/BTC, WLD/USDT Users can start depositing  WLD  now Withdrawals for WLD is tentatively set to open at  2023-07-25 09:00 (UTC) WLD Listing Fee: 0 BNB Note: The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status of withdrawals on the withdrawal page. In addition, Binance will add  WLD  as a new borrowable asset with this new margin pair on Isolated Margin, within  48 hours  from  2023-07-24 09:00 (UTC) : New Isolated Margin Pair:  WLD /USDT Please refer to   Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits and rates. What is Worldcoin (WLD)? Worldcoin is a digital identity protocol aiming to support humanity in the age of AI. WLD is its native utility token with governance properties.
